parts.note: Remaining scheduled session days in 2026: Dec. 1–3. The 104th General Assembly ends when the 105th is sworn in on Jan. 13, 2027; bills that have not passed both chambers by then expire and must be reintroduced.
The 119th Congress ends Jan. 3, 2027. Bills not enacted by then expire and must be reintroduced in the 120th Congress.
